records.full_test_name: Accuracy > should chain modifiers in order of the Pokemon's raw speed
records.applicability_evidence: The pinned assertion is a current-generation doubles construction using Gravity, Victory Star, Tangled Feet, No Guard, Bonsly, and Pyukumuku.
